resources.string: This app is an engine only. It plays the original Red Alert 2 using the game files from your own copy of the game; no game data is included.

How to add them:
 1. On your PC, put the files above from your Red Alert 2 install folder (the one holding ra2.mix) into a folder named RA2, and copy that folder into the phone's Download folder (USB file transfer, or: adb push into /sdcard/Download/RA2/).
 2. Tap IMPORT OR UPDATE GAME FILES. In the picker, OPEN the RA2 folder itself (Android does not allow picking Download, the storage root or a whole drive), then tap USE THIS FOLDER and ALLOW. Picking the folder that contains RA2 works too.
 3. The files are copied into the app (about 750 MB, under a minute) and the game starts. Keep this screen open until the copy has finished.

To add a custom map pack, first copy its extracted map files to the phone (or connect the drive by USB), tap IMPORT CUSTOM MAPS, then select the folder containing the .yrm, .map, or .mpr files. Maps are copied into the app without replacing game assets. Only maps supported by the current game mode and theater will appear in Skirmish.

Alternatively copy files over USB (MTP) straight into the folder shown above.
no Red Alert 2 game files in the picked folder. Open the RA2 folder itself (the one holding ra2.mix) and tap USE THIS FOLDER.
No .yrm, .map, or .mpr files found in the selected folder or its map subfolder.
Imported %1$d map file(s). Compatible maps will appear in Skirmish after restarting the game.
Import or replace the game files

You can import again at any time to add or replace files (campaign maps, music, patches, movies): long-press the app icon and choose Import game files, or in the game open Options, then Game Files. Your saves and settings are kept. If the game was already running, it reads the new files the next time it starts.
